proof_body:
by
  intro 𝕜 _ E _ _ M x hM
  have h : ‖(Submodule.Quotient.mk x : E ⧸ M)‖ = Metric.infDist x (M : Set E) := QuotientAddGroup.norm_mk x
  rw [h, ← hM.mem_iff_infDist_zero ⟨0, M.zero_mem⟩]
  rfl
target_source: ∀ (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] (M : Submodule 𝕜 E) (x : E), IsClosed (M : Set E) → (‖(Submodule.Quotient.mk x : E ⧸ M)‖ = 0 ↔ x ∈ M)
